script:
Start-Sleep -Seconds 75
$root = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\SD\VID_02D0&PID_A9A6&FN_1'
$k = Get-ChildItem $root | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.PSPath 'Device Parameters' } | Select-Object -First 1
$p = Get-ItemProperty $k
$names = 'Ver','ProbeState','Stage','Fw_Vf_Bad','Ht_Val','F2_Rdy_Val','Pre_Intr','Pre_Frames','Mb0','Mb1','Ver_St','Ver_Len','Clm_Read_St','Clm_Len','Clm_Chunks','Clm_Chunk_St','Clm_Chunk_At','Clm_Status_St','Clm_Status','Mac_St','Mac_Len','EvMask_St','EvMask_Status','Up_St','Up_Status','Escan_St','Escan_Status','Scan_Done','Scan_Ms','Ap_N','Ev_Total','Ev0','Ev1','Ev2','Ev3','Intr_Total','Frames_Total','Rx_BadHex','F2Rx_Err','F2Rx2_Err','Sh_Flags','Sh_Trap'
foreach ($n in $names) { $v = $p.$n; if ($v -ne $null) { if ($v -is [int]) { '{0,-14} = 0x{1:X8}' -f $n,[uint32]$v } else { '{0,-14} = {1}' -f $n,$v } } }
"Ioctl_Ver: " + $p.Ioctl_Ver
"Mac: " + $p.Mac
foreach ($i in 0..15) { $s = $p."Ap${i}_Ssid"; if ($null -ne $s -or $p."Ap${i}_Bssid") { "AP{0}: ssid='{1}' bssid={2} rssi={3} chanspec=0x{4:X}" -f $i,$s,(($p."Ap${i}_Bssid") -replace '\s',''),[int]$p."Ap${i}_Rssi",[uint32]$p."Ap${i}_Chan" } }
$c = [string]$p.Console
"--- Console (last 600) ---"; if ($c.Length -gt 600) { $c.Substring($c.Length-600) } else { $c }
